title: fix(cloud-connection): keep the binding credential under OS_HOME so a container recreate does not unbind the node
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9Le5aumc4yG69U5cTLGJxTM)_

Fixes #31604

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:单节点的云绑定凭据文件 `cloud-connection.json` 改为跟随 `OS_HOME`(设置时放 `OS_HOME/cloud-connection.json`,未设置时路径不变);首次启动把旧的工作目录文件搬过去一次。
- 为什么改:容器里工作目录在镜像层,重建容器(compose recreate、升级换镜像)会丢掉绑定,在线授权的节点立刻掉回 Community,直到有人重新绑定。
- 风险与回滚:只动文件位置与一次性搬迁;两边都有时以 `OS_HOME` 的为准、旧文件原样保留;显式 `credentialPath` 优先级不变;多副本共享存储未改。回滚即 revert 本 PR(已搬走的文件需手动搬回工作目录)。
- 先看:`packages/cloud-connection/src/connection-credential-store.ts`(解析与 `moveLegacyFile`)、`cloud-connection-plugin.ts` 的 `moveLegacyCredentialFile`、`local-manifest-source.ts` 的 `readOsHome`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection exec vitest run src/connection-credential-store.test.ts -t OS_HOME`,预期 6 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **One `OS_HOME` reading.** `readOsHome()` in `local-manifest-source.ts` is the reading the install ledger already used (#30217), extracted so the ledger resolver and the new credential resolver share it; the ledger's answers are unchanged (its suites are green on this head).
- **Credential path.** `resolveConnectionCredentialPath()` answers `OS_HOME/cloud-connection.json` when `OS_HOME` is set, and `CWD/.objectstack/cloud-connection.json` (unchanged) when it is not. `os start` in project mode sets `OS_HOME` to `CWD/.objectstack`, so its file does not move. An explicit `credentialPath` keeps its precedence and moves nothing.
- **Migration on boot.** `CloudConnectionPlugin.init()` calls `ConnectionCredentialStore.moveLegacyFile()` before choosing the ledger: when the old working-directory file exists and the `OS_HOME` file does not, the bytes are written 0600 to a sibling staging file, renamed into place (works across the image layer and the data volume, where a plain rename cannot), and only then is the old file removed. One `info` line names both paths and never the credential. Both present: the `OS_HOME` file is the binding and the old file is left untouched. A failed move is reported once at `error` with the consequence and the fix.
- **`os dev --fresh`.** Under the ephemeral home the run announces, the credential stays inside that home and the project's file is neither moved nor read.
- **Not touched:** the multi-replica shared store (`connection-credential-ledger.ts`, `connection-credential-preboot.ts`, `sys-cloud-binding-credential.object.ts`). Its scale-out adoption reads the same store object, so it now adopts from the `OS_HOME` file, after the move has run.
- Docs: `content/docs/deployment/cloud-connection.mdx` states the new location and the upgrade behaviour. Changeset: patch for `@objectstack/cloud-connection`.

## Why

The shipped image runs with `OS_HOME=/data` on a volume, but the credential resolved to the working directory inside the container layer. A restart kept it; a recreate lost it, and the exchange then answered "not bound".

## Tests

New top-level `describe` in `connection-credential-store.test.ts` (six cases): default store under `OS_HOME` and a bind writes there 0600; old file moved once (0600, one log line, nothing left behind, second boot silent); both present, new wins and old untouched; control with `OS_HOME` unset; `os dev --fresh` keeps it in the ephemeral home; explicit `credentialPath` precedence. No existing test was edited.

## Acceptance notes

- Seat review amended ruling 3 for prose only: the header comments of `connection-credential-ledger.ts` and `sys-cloud-binding-credential.object.ts` now say the single-node file follows `OS_HOME` and point at `resolveConnectionCredentialPath` (comment lines only, no code line in either file).
- `local-manifest-source.ts` is outside the claim's declared file surface; the seat accepted the `readOsHome` extraction as the one parser ruling 1 asked for.

## Verification

On `de5b1aa9`: package typecheck + Tests 1114 passed (1114); 99 derived gates all run, all exit 0, `--ran` 0 NOT-MEASURED 0 UNRUN; lint exit 0. The readings below are from `d6663391` unless they say otherwise.

<details><summary>Red on main: 4 of 6 new pins fail on 5d1382a5 source</summary>

The three source files restored from `5d1382a5`, the new tests kept: `Tests 4 failed | 17 passed (21)`. The four OS_HOME cases fail (e.g. `expected '/tmp/ccs-…/project/.objectstack/…' to be '/tmp/ccs-…/home/cloud-connection…'`; both-present: `expected 'oscc_legacy' to be 'oscc_home'`). The control (OS_HOME unset) and the explicit-path case pass on main, as they should.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation: six legs, each red, each restored (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs)</summary>

Tests import the source directly (no dist leg). Each leg: mutation landed (anchor count 1 to 0, blob changed), run red, restore proved by blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

- A1 drop the "new file exists" guard in `moveLegacyFile`: red `keeps the OS_HOME file when both exist…`
- A2 drop the ephemeral-home exclusion in the resolver: red `os dev --fresh…`
- A3 drop the removal of the old file: red `moves the working-directory file…` (`expected true to be false`)
- A4 stage the moved file 0644: red `moves the working-directory file…`
- A5 give an explicit path a legacy path: red `an explicit credentialPath keeps its precedence…`
- A6 drop the plugin's boot move: red `moves the working-directory file…`

A3 and A6 were first sent as empty replacements, which the tool refused before mutating (replacement count did not rise); re-run with `--delete`.
</details>
